notes.title: [0.16.2] Kanji Library& Chinese Language Support Added Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Overview[/h1]
In this update, we are excited to announce the addition of the Kanji Encyclopedia feature, as initially communicated! Now you can enjoy filling in the blanks as only the Kanji characters you've assembled will be displayed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698244/f0eb2c36df314d113eba65a0970a2f948d30fa78.gif[/img]

Additionally, to enhance the gaming experience for our Chinese-speaking users, we have added support for the Chinese language.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698244/1be8522c1342d6432e1e4d6ed9d86fc7e9010f87.png[/img]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the Kanji Encyclopedia
[list]
[*] View details such as the generation count, reading, and meaning of the assembled Kanji characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698244/67d7358a328fdd5a76bd7ce34d0dfeb11c43a2d5.png[/img]
[*] Check the Kanji assembly recipes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698244/f86f0cf5e0609817e91aaa1563de7bfd2c62b236.png[/img]
[*] Accessible from the title screen, world mode, and pause menu during stage mode.
[/list]
[*] Added the option to choose between Simplified and Traditional Chinese in the language settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698244/1be8522c1342d6432e1e4d6ed9d86fc7e9010f87.png[/img]
[*] Added several Kanji characters
[list]
[*] You can now assemble the following eight Kanji characters:
[list]
[*] 胡, 伯, 募, 暮, 墓, 慕, 壬, 任
[/list]
[*] The character "舌" can now be assembled with the combination of "ノ" and "古," in addition to the previous combination of "千" and "口."
[list]
[*] Previously, it could only be assembled with "千" and "口."
[*] In the future, multiple assembly recipes may be added for a single Kanji character.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698244/6edeabac7f75df2be2c84ad2e60a3497997ff94c.png[/img]
[*] Time within the game now stops when the pause menu is open.
[list]
[*] Convenient for considering production lines or taking a break to go to the bathroom.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: [0.15.0] Update to add Kanji characters&stages&improve operability&fix bugs
notes.content:
This update is somewhat full of volume!

[h1]Addition[/h1]

[list]
[*]Added a large number of kanji characters that can be created!
  [list]
  [*]We added a whopping 37 new kanji!
  [*]Added mainly the cursive and existing Kanji characters that should be able to be created but were overlooked.
  [*]丁, 可, 何, 奇, 恵, 旲, 唱, 卦, 簡, 腮, 叶, 辛, 辞, 什, 艹, 草, 芯, 苛, 昌, 苗, 茄, 苫, 荷, 萌, 菩,菖, 萠, 董, 蒔, 苦, 莫, 苻, 茴,茵, 苙, 莅, 薏
  [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698244/cfbd809e31469ce76d3e6b6ebc0a1a781a21485d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698244/147ffb71d8a1eb802c73633099b7f0ef98ca45a0.png[/img].

[*]More stages have been added.
  [list]
  [*]The number of variations for clearing each stage has been greatly increased from 25 to 101.
  [*]Most of the Kanji characters that can be created now appear as stage clear goals.
  [*]The number of stages that must be cleared before the final stage has been increased by two.
    [list]
    [*]The increase in Kanji characters means that the volume of the stage mode has increased.
    [/list]
  [/list]
[*] Added a list of machines on hand on the stage selection screen.
  [list]
  [*] Please use it as a reference for which stage to proceed to next.
  [/list]
[*] Added the ability to view the contents of stages you have cleared on the stage selection screen.
  [list]
  [*] I want you to feel a sense of accomplishment.
  [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698244/458a9354d436dd8af628f8b99812c30daa0f9036.png[/img].

[*] Added display of the most recent income and expenditure in the upper right corner of the screen in world mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698244/57944b6619771d5f53425438b3a7cecc53cbe7b9.gif[/img].

[*] The operating instructions in the lower right corner of the screen can now be hidden.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698244/7fba4ddbaf06e5051d98ee7ae715a3f6281051f8.gif[/img].
[/list]

[h1]Change[/h1]

[list]
[*]When a machine placement button is pressed while in machine placement mode, the machine placement mode will switch to that machine's placement mode.
  [list]
  [*]Previously, pressing the Q key was required to place another machine, which was cumbersome.
  [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698244/95873a574fbd1df0ee177e8b131966ca775291e4.gif[/img].

[*] Replaced the logo image on the title screen with an official one.
[*] Added Twitter and Discord link buttons in the lower left corner of the title screen.
  [list]
  [*] Please feel free to send us feedback!
  [/list]
[*] Added support for various window resolutions.
  [list]
    [*] You can now enjoy it in both small and wide windows!
  [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698244/9c1067050426ff926bea3a73d210789ed5265e6a.png[/img].
[/list]

[h1]Fix[/h1]

[list]
  [*] Fixed a bug that prevented pressing a button when the early access warning in the lower left corner of the title screen was covered by another button.
  [*] Changed the message when clearing the last stage to the early access one, since it was still the same as in the demo version.
  [*] Fixed a bug that prevents you from placing your machine in a square with a wild machine (a machine that has been placed there since the beginning) in the stage mode.
[/list]

notes.title: [0.14.0] First update after alpha version release!
notes.content:
[h1]# addition[/h1]
- Added Discord invitation URL to the bug report destination description on the title screen.

[h1]# change[/h1]
- Clicking on a generator during machine placement mode ends placement mode and opens the selection window.

[h1]# Fix[/h1]
- Fixed a bug where the underground transport would become disconnected when starting World Mode from where it left off.
- Fixed a bug where the layout of the target number of upgrades would collapse if it was 4 digits or more.
